units.Micah 7:3: They prepare their hands for evil; the ruler asks, and the judge spoke peaceful words—it is his soul’s desire. And I will remove
units.Micah 7:11: on a day of brick plastering. That day is your obliteration, and it will rub away your ordinances—
units.Micah 7:1: Alas! I have become like someone gathering stubble at harvest and a gleaning at vintage, with no cluster available to eat the first fruits. Alas, my soul,
units.Micah 7:2: for the devout person has perished from the earth, and no one acts rightly among people. They all litigate for bloodshed; each crushes his neighbor with crushing.
units.Micah 7:4: their good things like a moth eating away and walking upon a measuring rod on the day of watching. Woe, woe! Your punishments have arrived; now they will weep.
units.Micah 7:5: Do not put confidence in friends or hope in leaders. With your bed companion, beware of entrusting anything to her.
units.Micah 7:6: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter will rise against her mother, a daughter-in-law will rise against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are all the men in his house.
units.Psalms 27:1: Of David. To Thee, Lord, I cried; my God, do not keep silence toward me, lest Thou keep silence toward me and I become like those descending into a pit.
units.Psalms 27:2: Hear the voice of my petition as I petition Thee, as I lift my hands toward Thy holy temple.
units.Psalms 27:3: Do not drag my soul away together with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those working injustice, who speak peace with their neighbors while evils are in their hearts.
units.Psalms 27:4: Give them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their practices; give them according to the works of their hands; repay their recompense to them.
units.Psalms 27:5: Because they did not understand the Lord’s works or the works of His hands, Thou wilt pull them down and certainly not build them up.
units.Micah 7:10: My enemy will see and clothe herself in shame, she who says to me, “Where is the Lord your God?” My eyes will look upon her; now she will become a trampling place like mud in the streets
units.Micah 7:12: that day. Your cities will come to leveling and division among Assyrians, and your fortified cities to division from Tyre as far as Syria’s river—a day of water and tumult.
units.Micah 7:13: The land will become an obliteration together with those inhabiting it, from the fruits of their practices.
units.Ezekiel 13:10: Because they misled My people, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there was no peace, and this one builds a wall, and they coat it—if it is going to fall,
units.Ezekiel 13:11: say to those coating it, ‘It will fall.’ There will be a flooding downpour, and I will put stones for hurling into their bonds, and they will fall; there will be an upending wind, and it will be split.
units.Ezekiel 13:12: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will they not say to you, ‘Where is your coating with which you coated it?’
units.Ezekiel 13:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will unleash an upending blast with wrath; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and I will bring the projectile stones in wrath for complete destruction,
units.Ezekiel 13:14: and I will tear down the wall you coated, and it will fall. I will lay it upon the ground; its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 13:15: I will complete My wrath upon the wall and those coating it, and it will fall. I said to you, ‘There is no wall, nor those coating it—
units.Ezekiel 13:16: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and see peace for her, when there is no peace,’ says the Lord.’
